title: Place a wall piece
what: a painted piece set down on the board, one clack per cell

title: Stack a block on a wall
what: a block set on top of a wall, higher than the placement

title: Placement refused
what: a soft dull double knock, polite

title: Place a gun
what: a heavier set-down with an iron ring

title: Four cannons fuse into the heavy gun
what: a clatter, then a deep iron clunk

title: Rotate the held piece
what: a short wooden tick

title: Draw a new piece
what: a piece slides out of a box into a tray

title: A ring closes
what: a short rising chime as the ground takes the owner's colour

title: Battle phase starts
what: a bugle call, two rising notes

title: Build phase starts
what: a softer bell or whistle

title: Countdown tick
what: the last five seconds of a phase

title: A building outside a ring is lost
what: a short crackle and a puff at the check

title: Castle claimed
what: a chime sting with a flag going up

title: Castle lost
what: the claim chime falling

title: Castle becomes a ruin
what: a big collapse of stone

title: Cannon fires
what: the 1x1 gun, a tight boom

title: Heavy cannon fires
what: the 2x2 gun, a deep boom with a ring

title: A ship fires
what: the small boom further away

title: Shell hits the ground
what: a dull thud, a puff of dust

title: Shell hits a wall
what: a stone crack, a block tumbles

title: Shell hits a gun
what: an iron clang

title: Shell hits a castle
what: a heavy stone crack

title: Shell hits water
what: a plop and a splash

title: Shell hits a ship
what: a wooden crack and a creak

title: Wall or gun crumbles
what: stone blocks tumble and clatter

title: Ship sinks
what: the ship tips over: creak, splash, bubbles

title: Button hover
what: a very light tick

title: Button click
what: a crisp wooden tick

title: Map built
what: a bright chime when the loading ends
